title: The Enderian Crucible
description: Unleash cosmic power with new End-game tools and armor that surpass Netherite.
body:
In the silent, shifting landscapes of The End, The Enderian Crucible invites you to embark on an ultimate, cosmic odyssey, pushing the very limits of what's possible within this alien dimension.

At the heart of this mod lies Cosmonium, a material whispered about in ancient End texts, found only in the deepest, most mysterious pockets of its outer islands. Far surpassing the strength and resilience of conventional Netherite, Cosmonium Shards embody raw, untamed void energy, shimmering with the starlight of distant galaxies.

Your journey will demand mastery and perseverance as you seek out these rare shards, refine them into Cosmonium Alloy, and bind its power with the ethereal Cosmic String, a unique component vital for crafting the ultimate multi-tool.

With The Enderian Crucible, you will forge tools of unprecedented efficiency and durability. Adorn yourself in meticulously crafted Cosmonium armor, that offers unparalleled protection, imbued with the very essence of the cosmos. Every swing, every block mined, every challenge faced will be transformed by the sheer might of Cosmonium, ushering in a new era of end-game supremacy within The End. Prepare to claim your place as a true master of the void, reshaping your Minecraft experience with power drawn directly from its heart.

The Enderian Crucible: Development Roadmap

Here's a look at what we've accomplished so far and what cosmic wonders await in future updates for The Enderian Crucible!

**Current Version (Done)**:

  **Cosmonium Tool Set**:

Cosmonium Pickaxe (Ultimate mining efficiency and harvest level)

Cosmonium Axe (Superior woodcutting speed)

Cosmonium Shovel (Rapid excavation)

Cosmonium Hoe (Efficient tilling and plant harvesting)

Cosmonium Sword (Exceptional damage and attack speed)

Cosmonium Multi-Tool (Combines pickaxe, axe, and shovel functions into one powerful item)

  **Cosmonium Armor Set**:

Cosmonium Mask

Cosmonium Cuirass

Cosmonium Greaves

Cosmonium Boots

All pieces provide unparalleled defense, toughness, and knockback resistance.

  **Core Resources & Crafting**:

Cosmonium Ore (New mineral found in The End)

Cosmonium Shard (The raw form of Cosmonium, initial discovery)

Cosmonium Core (A concentrated, powerful form of Cosmonium)

Cosmonium Alloy (Refined material for crafting gear)

Cosmic String (A unique component used specifically for the Cosmonium Multi-Tool)

Custom Smithing Templates for upgrading gear.

Custom Upgrade Template Recipes for crafting the unique smithing templates.

Custom Advancement Tree: A dedicated advancement tab to guide players through discovering and mastering Cosmonium.

  **Coming Soon** (Planned Features):

We're just beginning to harness the true power of The End! Future updates will expand the world and mechanics of The Enderian Crucible:

  **New Blocks**:

Decorative Cosmonium variants (Bricks, Pillars, Glowing Blocks)

Functional utility blocks related to Cosmonium processing and energy.

**New Crafting Station**: A unique, custom crafting station central to the mod's progression and advanced recipes.

**New Mobs**: Unique entities inhabiting The End, both hostile challenges and potential sources of new resources.

**New Structures**: Mysterious formations and ancient ruins scattered across The End, hiding secrets and dangers.

**New Biomes**: Diverse and awe-inspiring sub-biomes within The End dimension, each with its own unique characteristics and resources.

**New Villagers**: Specialized traders or lore-keepers that can be found or unlocked in The End, offering unique trades and insights.

**New Enchantments**: Powerful enchantments exclusive to Cosmonium gear, granting unique abilities and further enhancing player power.

**New Potions**: Void-infused elixirs offering temporary buffs or unique effects tailored for exploration and combat in The End.
